contracts.text: Fixed columns/widths/destinations and Single/Extended types per row parser; RA ×24 then ÷360; epoch +2400000; identifiers right-trimmed of 0x20 only.
Read(buffer,510) then ReadLn per line; append after cursor keeps file order and duplicates; no blank/comment skip.
Picker: first in-window record (|ΔRA| < 1 h, NaN inside), Prior+Next back to it, keep record when L > sep, exit after |ΔRA| > 1 h or tail; first run only; no RA wrap; earlier wins ties.
Separation sqrt(((RA−rec.ra)·15/cos(Dec·K1))² + (Dec−rec.dec)²): divides by cosine of pointing Dec (fdivrp, GNU and LLVM agree). Not great-circle.

Association: hit sets receiver+0x4a2 := &TRadioLab+0x5f7, copies the record into that shared buffer (rep movs 0x565787 / 0x567a00) and writes receiver+0x51f := separation; miss sets +0x4a2 := nil, clears the first byte of +0x5f7 and leaves +0x51f stale.

Initial offset: TRcvr_Form1 FormCreate 0x5721d8 (VMT 0x571a6c, DFM OnCreate=FormCreate) zeroes, on its normal path (guard 0x5bce00 at 0x5721dc..0x572201, unidentified 0x450100/0x405c88), the 10-byte Extended receiver+0x51f..+0x528 at 0x572392..0x5723a0 (+0.0); the open caller creates the form when the form variable slot [[0x5b5b44]] is nil before calling the picker (0x56795d..0x5679d6). [I] class pointer 0x571a20 = VMT−0x4c.

Shared alias, conditional: receiver+0x4a2 points at the single TRadioLab+0x5f7 buffer, which TRadioLab.PulsarList1Click 0x567f80 (identity S/I) overwrites (0x567fd5) or clears (0x567fd9); no receiver-field write in the prefix 0x567f80..0x567fd9; callees 0x474408/0x476f40/0x47a010 not analysed. Coupling 0x573f78..0x573f91 compares +0x4a6 with the name behind the pointer and calls refresh 0x574ba4, which reads through it (0x574c83..0x574ca2). Applies only if the method on the same instance (event delivery not shown) runs while a receiver holds that pointer; static reading, not a reproduced run.
Bytes ≤ 1 MiB, rows ≤ 10000, non-empty; printable ASCII; LF/CRLF; final terminator adds no row.
Cut each line at 510 bytes; refuse lines < 454 bytes and interior blank lines; any refusal rejects the whole file.
ASCII decimal grammar with sign/exponent and surrounding spaces; non-finite results refused; Single fields Math.fround with a finite check. Not StrToFloat locale parity.

Doubles for Extended, Math.cos/Math.sqrt for fcos/fsqrt; no x87 equivalence. Empty or null catalog selects nothing; initial receiver offset null is an explicit web sentinel (never associated), distinct from the native initial +0.0 (RA-PS-04); no consumer, not migrated to 0.
The receiver association stores an owned, frozen snapshot of the record; the native shared-buffer alias (RA-PS-05) is not modelled.
